text:
sophia: Heads-up: PR #2489 is blocked by a flaky test on integ/shard7 — CI shows a failing snapshot diff and a nondet test failure. Can someone take a quick look? <https://git.internal/repo/pull/2489|pr/2489>

miguel: I'll take a look. Failing test looks like `TestKVCacheEvict`. Error: expected length 3 but got 4 intermittently. Repro only in CI so far.

devops-bot: Build 2489.1 failed on shard7. To trigger a targeted rerun: `/ci rerun pr/2489 shard=7-targeted`

jamal: Hypothesis: nondeterministic iteration order after eviction. Is the test assuming map iteration order? @sophia

sophia: Yeah it's iterating a map and asserting array order — lazy on my part. I can make the test order-independent, but would prefer a targeted rerun first to confirm it's flaky and not a regression.

miguel: Triggering a targeted rerun now to validate: `/ci rerun pr/2489 shard=7-targeted` — started at 1767845000. If it flakes consistently, I'll push a fix that sorts the keys.

nina: @miguel if you end up changing the test I can approve a small deterministic fix quickly. Alternately, is a snapshot-update acceptable here? What does the snapshot diff look like?

miguel: Snapshot diff is purely ordering in an array. Example snippet:
```diff
- ["a","b","c"]
+ ["b","a","c"]
```

jamal: :thinking_face: If it's only ordering, we could update snapshot, but better to fix the test to avoid future flakes. If you can push the sort today I'll review.

sophia: Merge window closes in ~2 hours. If the rerun passes, can we merge now? @nina can you approve once CI is green?

nina: :thumbsup: I'll watch for the green and a quick SHA check, then approve and merge within the window.

devops-bot: Targeted rerun completed at 1767845500 — shard7: PASS. Full CI still running: <https://ci.internal/build/2489.2|build/2489.2>

sophia: Great, thanks. Full CI is still in progress. If anything else shows up please ping here. :party_parrot: 

miguel: I opened PR #2490 with a small deterministic change (sort map keys before asserting). If we need a safer immediate unblock we can merge the snapshot-update, but prefer the test fix long-term.

nina: If full CI goes green I'll approve PR #2490 or accept the original with snapshot-update if you prefer fastest unblock. :rocket:

oncall-bot: Reminder: merging to main will trigger a canary deploy. Monitor the dashboard for errors for the next 30m after merge.

sophia: Noted. Closing the loop — will merge after green + approval. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround!
